The scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Colossolactone Vi and the transporter. The evidence highlights a potential mechanistic link, but the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain and requires additional experimental investigation.
